subject: english
stem:
The museum's free evening drew more local visitors than usual. The report covered only one evening and did not compare other months.
What would be the best answer after reading every sentence?
options: The report showed fewer visitors in every month
One free evening was linked to higher local attendance
Free entry always increases every museum's visitors

optionRationales.reason: The report showed fewer visitors in every month：未比較其他月份且當晚更多。
One free evening was linked to higher local attendance：one 與 linked 保持時間及因果邊界。
More local visitors came：漏掉單次觀察限制。
Free entry always increases every museum's visitors：單一晚不能推到所有博物館與永遠。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「涵蓋全文但不加入未被原文支持的人、時間、因果或普遍結論」可推出 One free evening was linked to higher local attendance；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 One free evening was linked to higher local attendance 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
